notes: Private state on the box was missing at start (fresh clone around 10:49 PM PT Nov 2): no last-edition time, seen, published, retry queue or post log. The subscriptions list on the box is the 70-channel public starter list, not the full export.

Remote yt-dlp host was unreachable for the first fetch (ssh key not matched to the configured host name); fetch fell back to box-local listing and succeeded (70/70 channels). Fixed the box ssh config alias, then transcripts, Whisper and frames ran on the remote host.
